page.overview:
What is Anti-Turtle Squad?

Following a bank robbery by the , mistaken for the , the local government of New York City establishes the Anti-Turtle Squad. Using their battletank cannon, the Anti-Turtle Squad freeze the Punk Frogs, who are saved by the Ninja Turtles.

Later, in the Stonewall Prison, the Anti-Turtle Squad shows up again, doing a failed attempt to defeat the Punk Frogs and the Ninja Turtles with knockout gas. Category:Organizations Category:Antagonists (1987 TV series) Category:Humans Category:1987 TV series characters Category:Paramilitary
